high_level_description: This image shows a black varsity-style jacket displayed on a mannequin in what appears to be a clothing store. The jacket is predominantly black with white accents, including white stripes on the collar, cuffs, and bottom hem. It features several embroidered details: On the left side of the chest, there is a large white "F" with a stylized design. On the right side of the chest, there is an oval emblem with a globe design inside it. Below the globe emblem, the words "Together connected" are embroidered in white cursive script.
